result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder, with the whole screen inside `#component` at 1280px wide. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't checked how it looks.

It has the "Team" heading, the "Invite Member" primary button, and the five members. Each member has a name, an email and a role select (Admin, Editor, Viewer) preset to the role you gave. It's static HTML and CSS only.

I followed `DESIGN.md` for colors, type sizes, radii and spacing.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo can't load without external assets. The file names them first and falls back to system fonts, so the heading and body text will look different from the spec unless those fonts are installed locally.
- **Labels:** Each select has a screen-reader-only label such as "Role for Maya Chen".
- **Column headers:** I added a small "Name / Email / Role" header row above the list, which you didn't ask for.

`session.json` was empty. `session.err` held only a model-name error, so neither affected the work.
